decisions.reason: Accessory line remains lower priority but supports after-sales and has low opportunity cost, so keep with moderate discontinuation risk.
Core box trailer line benefits from strong demand and home page placement, so keep with very low risk.
Specialized car transporter fills a niche but has narrower demand, so keep with moderate risk.
Low-bed trailers are key to commercial and heavy hauling offerings, so keep with very low risk.
High cover accessory complements enclosed trailers and remains useful, so keep with somewhat low risk.
